description: Rumble Run opponents and boss shrines (phase 8 family 13): the eight Rumble Run champions beside War Master Voone (family 01, F01.json), each with the three shrines of its class as three variants (the boss board shrine, armed by ShrineRules.Arm for the boss as for the run player) and the deck of that challenge range. Deck lists are transcribed from hearthstone.wiki.gg boss pages (read 2026-11-14), by card name; tools/dungeon-run-catalog (step encounters) resolves the names against facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json, checks every card (scripted, client card, boss admission on a catalog run) and writes data/dungeon-run/encounters-v1.json.
method: Each page's wikitext (index.php?action=raw) was read and its three deck tables transcribed in table order: the shrine (by dbfId, resolved against the client facts), then each card row with its quantity (a pool table without quantities lists each card once). The transcription was checked against a second, independent parse of the same tables and against family 01's hand transcription of War Master Voone's page (identical).

adaptations.note: The three Rumble Run challenge ranges (1-2, 3-5, 6-8) are three shrine variants of one row (early, middle, late), as War Master Voone's; a fight draws its variant from the run seed and the floor, not from the round. A champion meets the run in any round of the Rumble Run, so the row's tier is a recorded spread of the nine champions over the four combat tiers (round 1 here: tier 1), not a wiki fact.

The challenge 1-2 table is a pool of possible cards without counts (the wiki: 10 or 13 cards a game); the challenge 3-5 table lists challenge 4-5 counts (17, 29 and 30 cards; starred cards only at challenge 5). Both are brought to 30 cards by the deck rule (second copies of non-Legendary singles, then the curated class fillers); the Rumble Run teammates the champions play (their special cards) are not admitted for a boss and are left out, each recorded.
